description: This file defines the class ReportGeneratorService, which provides methods for generating, managing, and retrieving report data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionalities for handling report headers, data normalization, query building, and report saving related to the HRM reporting module.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorService
classes.description: A service class responsible for generating, retrieving, and managing report data including header construction, query building, data normalization, and report persistence within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorDao
methods.description: Retrieves the ReportGeneratorDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: isPimReport
methods.description: Checks if a report identified by reportId is of type 'PIM_DEFINED'.

methods.name: getHeaderData
methods.description: Constructs and returns HeaderData for a report based on its ID, merging display fields and groups.

methods.name: getHeaderGroupsForDisplayFields
methods.description: Generates header groups and columns based on display fields and their grouping information.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinitionByReportId
methods.description: Creates a Header object for a report including metadata such as name and column counts.

methods.name: getNormalizedReportData
methods.description: Executes report query, normalizes DTO data, and prepares it for output.

methods.name: getReportDataCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of data entries matching the report's filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportDataQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds and caches a Doctrine QueryBuilder wrapper based on filter parameters, including selections, joins, and filters.

methods.name: getHashKeyForFilterParamObject
methods.description: Generates a hash key for caching report query results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: setSortingAndPaginationParams
methods.description: Applies sorting, offset, and limit to the query builder based on filter parameters.

methods.name: setJoinsToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds necessary join clauses to the query builder for all specified aliases.

methods.name: setJoinToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a single join clause to the query builder for a given alias, respecting dependencies.

methods.name: savePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Saves a report with specified field groups, criteria, and include type, returning the saved Report entity.

methods.name: getInitializedFilterFieldInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a filter field instance of a given class initialized with selected filter field data.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldsByCriteria
methods.description: Creates filter fields based on user-specified criteria for report filtering.

methods.name: generateSelectedFilterFieldForIncludeEmployee
methods.description: Creates a filter field to include only current, past, or all employees based on includeType.

methods.name: modifySelectedFilterFieldValues
methods.description: Modifies filter field values for x and y if filter field classes support modification.

methods.name: getDisplayFields
methods.description: Retrieves and structures all display fields grouped by their groups, for use in report configuration.
